environment.platform: Apple Silicon macOS 26.5.1, Colima 0.10.3 using Apple Virtualization.framework, Ubuntu Noble Linux 6.8 arm64

stages.notes: This was an operator rerun after prior exposure. No naive learner prediction was possible. Because no prediction was captured before observation, prediction-before-reveal ordering was not exercised.

stages.response: The virtual link emitted IPv6 traffic before either side had an IPv4 address. Ping and route lookup returned Network is unreachable. After assigning same-subnet IPv4 identities, routes resolved to eth0 and the capture showed ARP before successful ICMP.

artifacts.description: Fifteen-frame virtual link-up capture with IPv6 neighbor solicitation, multicast listener reports, and router solicitation.
Before addressing, eth0 had no IPv4 inet line and ping plus route lookup returned Network is unreachable.
After assigning 10.10.0.1/24 and 10.10.0.2/24, each route lookup resolved to dev eth0 with the expected source address.
Six-frame virtual capture containing ARP who-has, ARP is-at, and two ICMP echo request and reply pairs.

stages.notes: The operational causal sequence was reproduced. Stage status remains review because system evidence is not learner-understanding evidence.
No independent learner explanation was collected during the operator rerun.
No changed-case learner response was collected during the operator rerun. No fresh changed-case transfer was run, so transfer evidence and its ordering were not tested.

summary.decisionBasis: Latest upstream Lesson 00 reproduced the target L2/L3 causal states, but an operator rerun cannot establish the bounded learning claim without locked learner prediction, explanation, and changed-case transfer evidence. No calibrated adjudication was performed, and the review-to-verdict step is unvalidated.
limitations: This was an operator reproduction after source exposure, not a learner study.
The VM retained tools installed during the previous run, so this was not a fresh-environment setup test.
No Raspberry Pi hardware, physical carrier, speed, duplex, or real Pi link-up chatter was tested.
tshark was unavailable and the lesson used its tcpdump fallback.
The optional interactive dashboard was not exercised.
The packet captures are identified by digest but are not redistributed in this repository.
No learner response was captured before observation, so the protocol's prediction-before-reveal ordering was not exercised in this run.
No calibrated human rubric, blind review, or validated automated adjudication was performed; the review-to-verdict step remains unvalidated.
Timestamps document the operator run but are not tamper-evident and do not by themselves establish ordering.
